fomod.Name: CS Water Mod
fomod.Author: Julioi005
fomod.Description: Custom water meshes, textures, sounds and shader tuning for Community Shaders, PIXL Renderer, Open Shaders or Bottled Shaders (pick one during install), plus the optional SKSE plugins WaterWind and WaterWade. IMPORTANT: for Community Shaders, PIXL Renderer and Bottled Shaders, this mod must load BELOW the renderer in your mod list load order, or its shader overrides will not apply (Open Shaders uses a settings override and has no such requirement).
